facts.text: InterContinental Miami is on Biscayne Bay on the downtown Miami skyline.
facts.excerpt: Discover InterContinental Miami, a luxury hotel and iconic fixture on the downtown skyline, located on Biscayne Bay.

facts.text: The waterfront location is steps from the arts and entertainment of Brickell.
facts.excerpt: Its waterfront location is steps from the arts and entertainment of Brickell.

facts.text: The hotel is steps from PortMiami, Bayfront Park and Brickell City Centre.
facts.excerpt: You're steps from the PortMiami, Bayfront Park, and Brickell City Centre.

facts.text: The hotel began in 1982 with Henry Moore's 18-foot, 70-ton Spindle sculpture.
facts.excerpt: The InterContinental Miami began in 1982 with art: Henry Moore's 18-foot, 70-ton Spindle sculpture.

facts.text: Architect Pietro Belluschi designed the Grand Lobby around the sculpture, with Italian marble and African wood.
facts.excerpt: Architect Pietro Belluschi designed the Grand Lobby around it, creating an elegant entrance with Italian marble and precious African wood.

facts.text: The rooftop pool has panoramic Biscayne Bay views, lounge seating and cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Discover the rooftop pool sanctuary at InterContinental Miami, where panoramic Biscayne Bay views meet stylish comfort. Relax in spacious lounge seating or reserve one of our luxurious cabanas

facts.text: The rooftop pool is heated, with poolside loungers, cabanas and poolside service.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a heated pool, poolside loungers, and cabanas with attentive poolside service.

facts.text: mySpa has 10 treatment rooms, including HydraFacial treatment and a couple's suite.
facts.excerpt: mySpa is the premier spa in Miami, with 10 spa treatment rooms, including HydraFacial treatment and a couple's suite.

facts.text: All guests receive complimentary access to the 24/7 fitness center, steam room and sauna.
facts.excerpt: All guests receive complimentary access to our 24/7 Fitness Center, Steam Room, and Sauna.

facts.text: Rooms feature pillow-top bedding, luxury linens, BYREDO amenities and Nespresso machines.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy plush pillow-top bedding, luxury linens, premium BYREDO amenities, and Nespresso machines.

facts.text: Rooms and suites blend modern elegance with tropical style.
facts.excerpt: Our guest rooms and suites blend modern elegance with tropical style

facts.text: Suite and Club InterContinental rooms include Club Lounge access with daily breakfast, afternoon tea and evening happy hour.
facts.excerpt: Suite and Club InterContinental rooms include access to the Club Lounge. Enjoy exclusive benefits: Daily breakfast, Afternoon tea, and Evening Happy Hour

facts.text: The Club InterContinental Lounge is on the 29th floor and offers views.
facts.excerpt: The newly reimagined 29th-floor Club InterContinental Lounge offers stunning views, personalized service, and exclusive privileges for Club guests.

facts.text: Toro Toro is a modern steakhouse serving dry-aged USDA Prime steaks cooked over a wood fire, rodizio-style.
facts.excerpt: Toro Toro is a modern steakhouse known for dry-aged USDA Prime steaks cooked over a wood fire and served rodizio-style.

facts.text: Bluewater is a rooftop bar with views of the cruise ships in port.
facts.excerpt: meander to our stunning rooftop bar. Enjoy refreshing drinks and light bites with tranquil, memorable views of the cruise ships in port.

facts.text: Noche de Arte showcases local artists inside the hotel's Gallery 100.
facts.excerpt: Our award-winning Noche de Arte series celebrates Miami’s vibrant creative community, showcasing local artists each month inside our Gallery 100.

facts.text: The hotel runs Nonstop Daily Experiences with culinary, art, culture and wellness activities.
facts.excerpt: Experience our dynamic program of Nonstop Daily Experiences featuring culinary, art, culture, and wellness activities.

facts.text: Pet guests receive a curated Bark Box featuring local vendors.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a stay at our award-winning dog-friendly hotel and receive a curated Bark Box featuring local vendors

facts.text: Minimum check-in age is 21.
facts.excerpt: **Minimum check-in age**: 21

facts.text: The hotel is about 7.2 miles from Miami International Airport.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Miami is conveniently located near Miami International Airport (MIA), approximately 7.2 miles away (11.59 kilometers) from the hotel.

facts.text: Event space includes SkyLawn, downtown Miami's only rooftop greenspace, overlooking the bay and city.
facts.excerpt: SkyLawn, downtown Miami’s only rooftop greenspace overlooking the bay and city

facts.text: The hotel calls mySpa the premier spa in Miami.
facts.excerpt: mySpa is the premier spa in Miami

facts.text: The hotel hosts the Orange Drop on New Year's Eve.
facts.excerpt: Originally a casino, it hosts the famous Orange Drop on New Year's Eve (25+ years).
